events.title: Live now: tidying up the Library of Alexandria!
events.summary: The Library of Alexandria never sleeps! 🐱📜The free demo is being played live, round after round: armfuls of scrolls carried back to their shelves, the toy each cat is guarding found at last, and every ability put to work, from the Apple of Knowledge to the charged jump. Each round starts a fresh library, with the scrolls scattered in new places.Want to tidy it yourself? events.summary: 🖥️ A smoother first launchSome of you saw a black or half-sized screen the first time you opened the demo (it could happen with 4K TVs, super-resolution settings or some multi-monitor setups). events.title: Demo update, shaped by your feedback! 1.0.8
events.summary: Thank you so much for playing the demo, and for every review and comment. They shaped this update. Here’s what changed:Start from the very beginning. The demo is now the whole library from scratch: no half-sorted floors, no red barriers, no “OUT OF DEMO” signs. Every floor, every door and every cat is open to you, and the demo ends once you’ve placed 192 scrolls.Every cat can be reached, so the demo can always be finished.A gentler first minute.
